result.summary: Overall the page layout is mostly clean; one minor inconsistency found regarding heart icon contrast on the 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The favorite/heart icon on the pizza card has a dark circular background while the same icon on the ramen card has a transparent/white outline style, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon button style (background color/opacity) across all promotional cards for consistency.
